clips.title: The story
paras: Ironband's Progress Report is a written dispatch detailing the troubles facing Prospector Ironband's excavation site in eastern Loch Modan. It conveys both an account of slow digging hindered by aggressive troggs and an urgent plea for more blastpowder.

Prospector Ironband's excavation in Loch Modan faces continuous disruption from local troggs. To keep the project moving forward, Ironband compiled this progress report to restate his desperate need for blastpowder. Carried first to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar and then forwarded to the Assembly of Explorers in Ironforge, the report documents the site's stalls while requesting heavy munitions. The dispatch quickly raises eyebrows among league leadership, as an ample supply of blastpowder was dispatched to Ironband weeks prior, leaving superiors wondering where the previous shipments vanished.
